limits: No independent held evaluation performed by this training program.
Repeated seeds share the same authored language corpus and are not independent language samples.
Serialized model bytes exclude the Python/sklearn runtime; arrays are separately counted, not total RSS.
This is new V5 code, not reconstruction of lost V4 files or results.

authorship.strict_requested_operation_contract: An unsupported request type is rejected even when special numeric data could make its answer coincide with a supported operation; e.g. singleton aggregate is not an at request.

public_corpus.label_audit_scope: Exact-text conflicts and declared grammar operand directions; does not establish independent human annotation correctness.

development_diagnostic_only.interval_scope: descriptive fixed-query counts, not a selection-adjusted or population safety guarantee

selection.interval_scope: descriptive fixed-query counts, not a selection-adjusted or population safety guarantee

primary.selection_rule: Among selection risk-feasible candidate/calibration pairs, maximize correctly accepted known count, then minimize accepted wrong known, OOD false accepts, actual serialized selected-state bytes, candidate name, confidence, margin. Coverage >=0.8 remains a separate mandatory gate. Include explicit reject-all fallback. Development diagnostic results never select a candidate.
